items.title: HEX token sellers erase $160M following reports of founder Richard Schueler arrest
items.summary: The HEX token price declined by 30% following local media reports of the Istanbul arrest of founder Richard Schueler.

items.title: Ledgers answer to wallet tampering costs $849 and ships next year
items.summary: Ledgers new Atom combines crypto wallet security with everyday apps and is expected to ship in summer 2027 amid investigation into tampered wallets.

items.title: White House crypto council chief Patrick Witt steps down
items.summary: Witts departure leaves a leadership gap at the White House Crypto Council and marks the fourth high-profile exit from the advisory group.

items.title: Starknet opens vote on potential Ethereum L2 exit over quantum risks
items.summary: Starknet is asking STRK holders whether to explore becoming an independent layer-1 blockchain to reduce dependence on Ethereums quantum-security timeline.

items.title: Bitget, Liquid exploits push Q3 crypto hacks toward $1.2B
items.summary: Compromised suppliers, developer tools and infrastructure components outside security audits drove about 77% of the quarters total losses, according to Hacken.

items.title: Bitcoin dips to $80.1K as KOSPI closes at its lowest since April
items.summary: Bitcoin price action continued to see contagion from a Korean tech sell-off after the KOSPI Index fell 7.5% on Thursday.

items.title: Zcash Tanks Double Digits After Meteoric Rise Sees Leverage Build Up
items.summary: Experts blame a build up in leverage for Zcashs drop in value, as well as growing concerns about AI breaking crypto encryption.

items.title: Morning Minute: Solana Is About To Get Faster
items.summary: Alpenglow is coming next week, slashing Solana finality from 12.8 seconds to a target of about 150 milliseconds.

items.title: Bitcoin Tests $81,000 as Rate Hike Fears Linger After Hot Inflation Data
items.summary: Odds of an October Fed hike have climbed to 29% from 18% a week ago, and analysts see Bitcoin range-bound until the picture clears.

items.title: Brooklyn Prosecutors Take Down 112 Servers Behind Crypto Scam Targeting Russian Speakers
items.summary: The scammers also ran a fake recovery service, contacting victims weeks later with promises to get their stolen crypto back.

items.title: Helius CEO Mert Mumtaz joins NEAR Foundation Council
items.summary: Helius CEO Mert Mumtaz joined NEAR Foundations Council, which oversees the foundation and its most significant decisions.

items.title: Ledger unveils Atom Android device with Solana Mobile integration and new tamper protections
items.summary: Ledger unveiled Atom, an Android-based security device with Solana Mobile integration, AI-agent controls, and hardware-tampering protections.

items.title: EBA designates Circles USDC as the EUs first significant e-money token
items.summary: The EBA classified Circles USDC as the EUs first significant e-money token, with new supervisory responsibilities beginning Nov. 12.

items.title: Bitcoin drops below $81,000 as risk-off sentiment weighs on Asian equities
items.summary: Asian equities tumbled on Thursday, with South Koreas Kospi losing 8% and Japans Nikkei 225 declining 5% during morning trading.

items.title: Crypto scammers stole millions from victims, then returned pretending to help recover their money
items.summary: Prosecutors say recovered data showed the same scammers returning weeks later with false promises to recover stolen assets.

items.title: Bitcoins AI-driven rally faces a hidden danger if the machines get richer but workers dont
items.summary: Bitwise CIO Matt Hougan argued that nearly every macroeconomic path ends with Bitcoin higher, including an AI productivity boom.

items.title: Bitcoins $80,000 buy wall hides a liquidation trap that could send prices toward $78,000
items.summary: Bitcoin registered an intraday low near $81,500 on Oct. 14 as September CPI came in hotter than forecast.

items.title: 9 mega banks block crypto accounts, but new OCC rules bite back
items.summary: New OCC findings put crypto restrictions in a nine-bank record, while AML, sanctions and operational assessments still shape access.

items.title: Russias Central Bank Authorizes Sberbank to Exchange Cryptocurrencies
items.summary: Sberbank will debut its bitcoin-related products in December after receiving authorization from Russias central bank.

items.title: Kraken Parent Company Payward to Buy Saldo Bank in European Banking Push
items.summary: Top crypto exchange Kraken is pushing to offer other services other than digital assets via a European bank acquisition.

items.title: Standard Chartered Debuts Bitcoin Trading For Wealthy UAE Clients
items.summary: The service allows affluent clients to buy bitcoin via their bank accounts.

items.title: How Brooklyn prosecutors and the FBI took down a massive crypto fraud network targeting Russian speakers
items.summary: The scheme allegedly stole tens of millions through Russian-language Facebook ads and fake advisers, then went after victims again with fake recovery offers.

items.title: Under pressure Ledger unveils plan to turn its crypto hardware wallet into a smartphone
items.summary: Ledgers Atom will run apps like WhatsApp and Instagram and let users switch between smartphone functions and a protected mode for managing digital assets.

items.title: Bitcoin holds above $80,000 as Asian stock rout drags altcoins lower
items.summary: Bitcoin fell to just above $80,000 as South Koreas Kospi plunged 8%, while the CoinDesk 80 fell 2.2% and all but six CoinDesk 100 members declined.

items.title: Hyperliquid founder wants U.S. oversight of trading platforms, not his blockchain
items.summary: Jeff Yan told Bloomberg that U.S. regulatory oversight should apply to the firms using the blockchain, not to the underlying network itself.
